headline.zh-CN: 修正社团专辑的评审人候选名单
headline.en: Corrected reviewer candidates for circle albums

summary.zh-CN: 指派评审人时的候选名单现在由后端统一生成，与实际的指派校验规则完全一致；社团专辑中不再出现无法被指派的候选人（例如未加入社团的专辑制作人）。
summary.en: The reviewer candidate list shown when assigning reviewers is now generated by the backend, fully matching the actual assignment validation rules; circle albums no longer offer candidates who cannot be assigned (such as an album producer who is not a circle member).

title.zh-CN: 评审人候选名单与指派规则保持一致
title.en: Reviewer candidates now match assignment rules

description.zh-CN: 此前候选名单由前端按专辑成员和社团成员自行拼接，社团专辑可能列出不属于社团的专辑制作人，选择后会被后端拒绝。现在候选名单改由后端接口统一提供，只包含真正可指派的用户，并自动排除曲目作曲者和已停用账号。
description.en: Previously the candidate list was assembled on the frontend from album and circle members, so a circle album could list an album producer outside the circle, whose selection would then be rejected by the backend. Candidates now come from a backend endpoint and only include users who can actually be assigned, automatically excluding track composers and deactivated accounts.
